title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-12
body:
Morning scratchpad - quick running notes

Context: triaging perf regressions after the kernel reorder from PR 2413. Observed tail-latency spikes on 2xA100 pool during mixed-batch workloads (seq_len 1024, batch 8-32).

---
TO DO (priority order)
- Reproduce locally with --trace-kernels --seq 1024 --mixed-batch (use repro harness: tools/repro/mixed_batch_runner)
- Add detailed perf counters around cuBLAS/cuDNN launches + memcpy (PR 2418?)
- Roll forward fallback to old kernel selection for canary (region us-west2) if tail > 95th baseline
- Add unit test for kv-cache eviction during mid-generation truncation (ticket JIRA-ENG-7891)

---
BUG TRIAGE NOTES
- Incident summary: increased 95th latency from ~120ms to ~220ms for some requests. Not all models impacted; mostly decoder-only long-context variants (gptx-16k variants).
- Hypothesis 1: kernel reorder altered workspace allocation and increased memcpy overhead for large seqs. Evidence: memcpy rate jumps in perf logs around time of regression.
- Hypothesis 2: scheduler batching path now picks larger micro-batches (optimistic packing) and causes throttling during memcpy peaks.
- Next steps: isolate by forcing single-request batching (disable packing) and measure.

---
EXPERIMENTS RUN / NOTES
- Ran mixed_batch_runner with --profile on devbox-a100-1: peak memcpy 1.8x higher after reorder.
- Kernel timeline shows extra kernel launch between attention and feedforward on step boundary (suspect new op for kv-cache compaction).
- Quick patch: add metric "kv_compaction_time_ms" around the compaction call; pushed to branch perf/kv-metrics.

---
KERNEL-LEVEL IDEAS / REMINDERS
- Check that attention kernel uses batched dot-product fused path for seq_len>512; fallback currently triggers for certain dtypes (fp16/4bit mix). Could be incorrectly triggered by quantization flag.
- Revisit quantized matmul kernel selector: add check for contiguous layout (our reorder may create non-contiguous views). If non-contiguous -> memcpy.
- Consider introducing lazy compaction: only compact when cache size > threshold OR when next-op requires contiguous layout. Avoid compaction on short generations.

---
DEPLOYMENT / ROLLOUT NOTES
- Canary rollout paused at 30% on dedicated due to SLO alerts. Ops notified (cc: @Priya). Suggest fast rollback to kernel-selector v1 for canary nodes in us-west2.
- If rollback not possible quickly, set autoscale min-backlog to 2 per worker to smooth spikes.

---
QUICK REMINDERS / MISC
- Sync with Priya 1:30pm: go over perf traces and decide canary rollback window.
- Add a section in perf-runbook about kv-cache compaction heuristics (short note -> confluence page).
- Follow up on PR 2413 comments: @Liam asked to add benchmark artifacts for 8/16/32 batch sizes. Need to upload CSVs to GH artifacts.

---
OPEN QUESTIONS
- Is the compaction op new to this PR or was it exposed differently? (diff look: compaction moved from post-encode to pre-attn in pr 2413).
- How often does non-contiguous layout occur in practice (profile across production traces)? Need sampling job.

---
ENDNOTES
- Logging: add trace id to perf logs for correlation (format: run-<date>-<short-hash>).
- If time today: prototype lazy compaction and run against repro harness. Otherwise schedule tomorrow morning.
